title: Work Review: Retaining Talent and Team Spirit

review_words.key_point_zh: 阅读中常作 keep / maintain 的同义替换；谈留住人才用 retain staff，但“保持质量、标准”要说 maintain quality，不用 retain。
review_words.example: The firm introduced flexible working mainly to retain skilled engineers.
review_words.translation_zh: 这家公司引入弹性工作制，主要就是为了留住熟练工程师。
review_words.note_zh: retain 后直接接人或信息作宾语：retain staff / employees / information，不加介词。

review_words.key_point_zh: 表“前途”时多用复数 job / career prospects，听力和经济类阅读高频；the prospect of doing sth 常用来引出对未来的预测。
review_words.example: Many graduates accept unpaid internships in the hope of better career prospects.
review_words.translation_zh: 许多毕业生接受无薪实习，希望换来更好的职业前景。
review_words.note_zh: career / job prospects 习惯用复数；若用 prospect of，后面接动名词：the prospect of working abroad。

review_words.meaning_zh: 被裁员的；多余的、累赘的
review_words.key_point_zh: 听力中 be made redundant 就是 lose one's job 的同义替换；写作中指论据“重复累赘”，与 superfluous 相近，但不说 surplus。
review_words.example: Several administrative posts became redundant once the new software was installed.
review_words.translation_zh: 新软件装好之后，几个行政岗位变得多余了。
review_words.note_zh: be made redundant 强调“被裁员”；become redundant 也可指职位本身被撤，主语常是 post、position。

review_words.key_point_zh: 教育与管理类文章常考，强调“自己做决定的权利”，与 independence 辨析；固定搭配 give / grant sb autonomy over sth。
review_words.example: Staff who are given autonomy over their schedules often report greater job satisfaction.
review_words.translation_zh: 在时间安排上获得自主权的员工，往往表示工作满意度更高。
review_words.note_zh: autonomy 不可数，常说 a degree of autonomy；介词用 over 表“对……有决定权”。

review_words.meaning_zh: 士气、斗志（群体的精神状态）
review_words.key_point_zh: 谈团队状态时多与 boost / raise morale、morale is low 搭配；拼写别和 moral（道德的）混淆，也不能用来指个人动力（用 motivation）。
review_words.example: Morale improved noticeably after managers began holding short weekly team meetings.
review_words.translation_zh: 经理们开始每周开短会之后，士气明显提升。
review_words.note_zh: morale 不可数，主语常与 rise / fall / improve 连用；动词搭配 boost / raise / lift morale。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you hear the design team lost three people last month?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and two of them weren't made redundant at all — they left for better career prospects elsewhere.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's the real problem. We can't retain good designers if they never get a say in what they work on.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. Managers talk about efficiency all day, but people are given very little autonomy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And morale drops when nobody explains why decisions are made.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So what would you change if you could?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'd let each team set its own weekly priorities and report back monthly, instead of asking for approval on everything.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds workable — a degree of autonomy plus clearer communication might stop the exits.

quiz.question: Which word is closest in meaning to "retain" in: "Flexible hours help firms retain experienced staff"?
quiz.explanation_zh: retain 强调“不让人或物失去”，此处最接近 keep。preserve 强调保护以免损坏，多接文物、传统、自然环境；recover 是“找回、恢复”。

quiz.question: New employees are usually given a fair degree of autonomy ___ how they organise their working day.
quiz.explanation_zh: autonomy over sth 表示“对某事的决定权”，是固定搭配；a degree of autonomy 也是高频组合。

quiz.question: After the merger was announced, ___ in the branch office fell sharply and several experienced staff resigned.
quiz.explanation_zh: 此处指群体在压力下的整体精神状态，用 morale，且 morale fell 是常见搭配。motivation 多指个人驱动力；spirit 常见于 team spirit，不用于 fell sharply 这种量化下降。
